falsification_criteria: Discard unless learned parallel improves aggregate bits per byte by at least 0.05 and exact-span accuracy by at least 0.02 versus both source-identical one-sweep and frozen-factor roles, with no lower byte accuracy.

Discard unless learned parallel beats the strongest complete implementable classical control excluding privileged oracle by at least 0.05 bits per byte and 0.02 exact-span accuracy overall and in each K cell at rounds 4 and 6.

Discard if the learned role has nonmonotone accepted energy, fails consistent byte-relabeling equivariance, accesses targets or same-sweep proposals, omits factor-by-iteration costs, exceeds six internal sweeps or 4194304 state bytes, or lacks bounded three-span critical-depth slope below 0.5.

invalidation_rules: Invalidate on any frozen corpus mismatch or overlap with the EXP-0044 corpus.

Invalidate on post-score tuning, seed leakage, byte-permutation leakage or evaluator-integrity change.
